Mirza travels to Aleppo to find his nephew and the brother-in-law who abducted him. However, Aleppo will return to Mirza not only Kerem but also Leyla, who has left him in agony for seven years. As Mirza fights a grueling battle to rescue Leyla and 6-year-old Hüma—whom he does not know is his own daughter—from Syria, a fierce struggle against his own family awaits him in Cappadocia.

overview: 1921... Jao Karmfah is a nobleman from Chiang Mai. As an arrangement by family members, he is engaged to Yaowalak. After returning to Chiang Mai for business, he falls in love with Fongkae at first sight. Karmfah decides to break off his engagement with Yaowalak to pursue Fongkae. However, Fongkae already has a man she loves, Khun Chai Yingsak Warangkorn. Fongkae's parents prefer Karmfah as their son-in-law and locks Fongkae away, pending her nuptials to Karmfah. Yingsak sneaks into Fongkae's home and takes her away. Upon hearing of this, Karmfah quickly chases them. When he finds them, he realizes that he cannot force anyone to love him. Just as Yaowalak could not force him to love her. He allows them to be together, and gives Fongkae a hair brooch he had specially crafted for her. Fongkae and Yingsak would go on to have two children, Mom Luang Sakchai and Mom Luang Sommapa. Yaowalak, who was labelled as a disgrace by society when her fiance abandoned her, meets Than Chai Kietkong Suppakhun. He quickly becomes smitten by Yaowalak. But he has a secret relationship with one of the royal servants in his palace, Pleum. Pleum would fall pregnant with Kietkong shortly before he is to wed Yaowalak. Pleum keeps the pregnancy a secret and marries the royal chauffeur, Fu. Pleum would give birth to Plaewadee. Kietkong marries Yaowalak and has a daughter, Mom Ratchawongse (Khun Ying) Yorkiet, nicknamed Yingyor. The lives of their children would later become intertwined with the brothers Pakinai and Pubadee. Both are children of Yaowalak and Kietkong's close friends. The decisions of their parents will bring upon a complicated and tangled web of deceit, love, and lies. However, the story does not end with the children, as the parents will also have to answer for their own desires and loves.
title: Love's Tempest

She journeys with confidence, knowing that—no matter what— her prince on a white horse will always come to save her if she falls.

When Namphet's situation changes, Ploy, the baby girl, ends up living with Nongnuch in a slum, growing up without knowing her true biological relationship. Ploy takes on various roles to provide for her family, with Klatawan's support. Namphet's relentless search for her daughter ends with Ploy, and she secretly helps her. Nongnuch becomes aware of Namphet's affluence and schemes to use Ploy for her benefit.

title: The Heart of Justice

overview: The series tells the story of Mesut Bağımtıbar, a marriage registrar who dreams of marrying off his five daughters. However, each of his daughters has a completely different personality. The most striking character among the daughters is the eldest, Zeynep.

overview: This live-action children's comedy follows a teenage girl adjusting to a fresh start in a quiet Devon town after her family relocates. To help smooth the transition, her new stepfather gifts her a pet dog. The twist: the dog secretly possesses the ability to talk, and she is the only person who knows! Mischievous, loud-mouthed, and wildly opinionated, the canine companion constantly drags his owner into ridiculous everyday scrapes, but despite the inevitable chaos, the two form an unbreakable bond as best friends.

overview: Follows an idealistic dad who volunteers to coach his kids' Little League team and discovers that the most unruly players aren't the ten-year-olds but the other coaches, parents, and sometimes himself. For the first time in 33 years, the original cast of The Sandlot reunites on screen in Dugout Dads, a heartfelt comedy about a first-time Little League coach who quickly discovers that while the kids are just there to have fun, the adults are playing for keeps.

overview: Η Μάρθα Φασιανού και ο Παύλος Πετρίδης είναι συνάδελφοι σε ένα γραφείο εισαγωγών και εξαγωγών, όπου καθημερινά έρχονται αντιμέτωποι με τα μικρά και μεγάλα προβλήματα της ελληνικής πραγματικότητας. Η Μάρθα, ύστερα από δύο αποτυχημένους γάμους, έχει αποφασίσει να μην ξαναπαντρευτεί, ενώ ο Παύλος είναι παντρεμένος με την Ελένη και προσπαθεί παράλληλα να διαχειριστεί το πολύχρωμο οικογενειακό του περιβάλλον: τη χωρισμένη αδελφή του Μπέτυ, την καταπιεστική μητέρα του Αφροδίτη και την πεθερά του Ζωρζέτ, η οποία έχει γνωρίσει τον Ανδρέα Χασιώτη και σκέφτεται να ξαναπαντρευτεί. Μέσα από τις επαγγελματικές, οικογενειακές και προσωπικές περιπέτειες των ηρώων, δημιουργούνται συνεχώς κωμικές καταστάσεις και παρεξηγήσεις που σατιρίζουν την καθημερινότητα και τη νοοτροπία των μικρομεσαίων Νεοελλήνων της εποχής.
title: Οι Μικρομεσαίοι

overview: Song Jingnan spends ten years devoted to an intense and unrequited love for Fu Siyuan. For years, she gives him her companionship and affection, hoping that one day he will finally see her feelings. When Jiang Yuning returns to China, Fu Siyuan's heart begins to waver. Unable to let go of his childhood sweetheart while still clinging to the comfort of Song Jingnan's years of devotion, he becomes caught between the two women. His hesitation and emotional distance gradually fill their relationship with suspicion and disappointment. Eventually, Song Jingnan becomes exhausted from waiting. She finally realizes that continuing to chase someone who cannot give her the love she deserves means losing herself in the process. Choosing to step away, she withdraws from Fu Siyuan and begins focusing on her own life and happiness. Only after losing Song Jingnan does Fu Siyuan realize how much she meant to him. He finally understands that the childhood love he had held onto for so long was never something he could truly have, while the person who had always been by his side was the one he had taken for granted. Meanwhile, Gu Yanting, who has quietly loved Song Jingnan for many years, begins to enter her life. Without forcing her or demanding anything in return, he patiently stays by her side, giving her the care and affection she once spent years longing for. With the past behind her and a new love waiting ahead, Song Jingnan must decide what she truly wants. After ten years of unrequited love, will she return to the man she once devoted everything to, or will she finally choose herself—and the person who has loved her all along?
title: The Moon Over The Sea Is The Moon In The Sky

overview: Across Europe, world-famous heritage sites such as Mont-Saint-Michel, Bran Castle, the Alhambra and Duart Castle draw visitors for their history and beauty. Yet beneath their grand façades lies a lesser-known story. Shaped by centuries of human activity, these sites and their surrounding landscapes are now home to a surprising range of wildlife, from harbour seals and red deer to black storks and elusive amphibians. This two-part series explores how Europe's most celebrated landmarks and the animals that live among them have become closely intertwined, using specialist wildlife filming to reveal nature thriving in historic places.
title: Europe's Wild Kingdoms

overview: Tong Xue is deeply entangled in complex layers of conflict. For three years, she has been by the side of the aloof and reserved Mo Shaoqian, their relationship a tumultuous mix of love and hate, filled with unspoken endurance. An unexpected reunion with an old acquaintance brings a cascade of misunderstandings that continually pull the two apart. She holds fast to her true self, finding her own path forward through her talent, while he learns to let go of his obsessions and makes peace with his past.
title: Thousand Mountains Evening Snow

overview: Surely, had Cinderella been a young woman in the year 2000, her path to happiness would undoubtedly have been different; instead of scrubbing floors, she would be looking for work just to get by, and she wouldn't ask her fairy godmother for a dress or a carriage, but rather for time and the chance to do what she loves in life. Furthermore, she wouldn't sit around waiting for Prince Charming to rescue her; instead, she would go out and find him herself—showing us who would actually be rescuing whom—because times have definitely changed.

overview: About a pair of childhood lovers who get together after experiencing a breakup from their previous relationships

overview: When Afghan refugee Abbas Nazari boards a dilapidated Indonesian fishing vessel with over 400 others in 2001, he has no idea he's about to be at the centre of one of the most dramatic chapters in Australian history. Tampa: The Turning Point re-examines the August 2001 MV Tampa crisis, marking 25 years since the eight-day maritime standoff that reshaped Australian border protection and global immigration policies.

overview: Following the assassination of the Russian ambassador, the case falls to Deputy Commissioner Gutierrez, a police officer ill-prepared for such a task. When the CIA, led by Mike Robinson, takes control, Gutierrez decides to play by his own rules. With a team as loyal as it is incompetent and methods of dubious legality, he will unleash chaos to demonstrate who's boss in his territory and solve the case before the Americans.

overview: Paolo's ordinary working-class existence is upended when he encounters the ambitious, and magnetic local politician Téophane, an old school mate. overview: Psychology PhD Lin Qingwan transmigrates into the body of a disgraced concubine banished to the Cold Palace after being falsely accused of poisoning the emperor's heir. With her entire family executed, she is trapped in a deadly predicament. Using psychological analysis to see through people's motives, forensic toxicology to unravel conspiracies, emergency medicine to save herself and others, and economic expertise to reform the imperial government, she begins by winning over the eunuchs of the Cold Palace. Leveraging the emperor's attention, she rises step by step until she is made Imperial Noble Consort. She exposes the Duke of State-Defending's conspiracy to frame her family, clears their name, and avenges their deaths. When the emperor falls gravely ill, she confesses her identity as a transmigrator. Ultimately, she earns his trust, takes over the imperial court, and ascends the throne, becoming Dasheng's first female emperor. She introduces the imperial civil service examinations for women, revises inheritance laws, opens a new Silk Road, and establishes the Tiangong Institute. Breaking the shackles of feudal society, she ushers in an era of prosperity and splendor. This is the legendary story of a modern, educated woman who uses her knowledge and abilities to defy fate and change her destiny. Watch as she fights her way out of a deadly predicament and rises to become an emperor remembered throughout the ages.
title: From Cold Palace to the Throne

overview: Zhou Cancan, a clearheaded and confident manager focused on making money, and Li Jinshu, a secretly wealthy heir who is aloof on the outside but innocent at heart, find themselves in a double identity mix-up as workplace rivals and online lovers. As they spend time together amid the everyday bustle of Chengdu, their bickering and push and pull gradually turn into mutual love.

overview: As Big Brother returns this autumn on ITV2 and ITVX for its biggest series yet, Big Brother: The Group Chat will give fans even more action, bringing them closer to the personalities, dynamics and relationships at the heart of the series. With exclusive interviews with evicted Housemates, celebrity fans and special guests, viewers can expect strong opinions, plenty of personality and the inside scoop from those who know the house best. From the biggest moments to the hot topics sparking conversation, Kate and GK will be on hand to dissect the drama, celebrate the stand-out scenes and weigh in on the decisions and surprises shaping the game. Whether it's an unexpected shake-up, an unlikely alliance or a moment that has everyone talking, Big Brother: The Group Chat will be the place to continue the conversation after Big Brother each night.

overview: Archive X: Unexplained Phenomena builds upon Rice University's Center for the Impossible, one of the world's largest collections of paranormal research, by inviting everyday individuals, many of whom have never spoken publicly before, to reveal their new and personal encounters with unexplained phenomena.

overview: The new series follows former "Flipping Out" star Jeff Lewis as he navigates the demands of his hit SiriusXM show on Radio Andy, an eponymous design empire, and everything in-between. The king of controlled chaos with a charged personality, Jeff is as outspoken as ever, but this time the mic is always on. As he works to balance his professional and personal lives, his trademark spontaneity collides with the people who work with him, for him and still somehow survive him.

overview: Forward-thinking designers, entrepreneurs, and everyday citizens are profiled as they develop practical, eco-friendly alternatives to traditional practices across everyday areas like fashion, architecture, food, and transportation. By highlighting cutting-edge green technologies and sustainable lifestyle choices, an optimistic, solutions-oriented look is provided into how human ingenuity and everyday innovations can help combat the global environmental crisis to build a healthier, greener world.
